sentences.text: The case of the revisionist is that he was residing in Japan for work purpose when he and the complainant connected through a matrimonial website.
He travelled to India on 10.02.2021 and got married to complainant on 14.02.2021 at Arya Samaj Temple.
The revisionist returned to Japan the next day.
On advise of his parents, he returned to India to perform marriage in presence of relatives and friends.
He, accordingly, returned to India on 15.04.2021.
Marriage in presence of relatives was solemnized on 19.04.2021 in a simple ceremony.
No kind of demand was raised by the revisionist or his family members.
On the next day, parents of the revisionist got infected with Covid-19 infection and were quarantine for three weeks.
The revisionist and the complainant had planned to return to Japan on 21.05.2021, however, owing to Covid- 19 pandemic, Government of Japan banned the entries of citizens from other countries.

The revisionist and the complainant stayed in India,
however, the complainant was not satisfied and she left her matrimonial house on 17.02.2022 along with her belongings.
On 06.04.2022, revisionist returned to Japan to restart his work.

10. It is further noted that at the time when Ld. Trial Court had dismissed the application of the revisionist-accused seeking cancellation of LOC, he had yet not joined the investigation.
It is not disputed that the revisionist-accused has now joined investigation.
Further, the IO has submitted that the charge-sheet would be filed within next 20 days.
It shows that material part of the investigation qua the revisionist has already been conducted.
No permission to arrest the revisionist-accused in the present case has been sought.
IO has not expressed any requirement of custodial interrogation of the revisionist-accused in the present case.

sentences.text:
The questions raised in the reference are as under:
"A. What are the categories of cases in which the investigating agency can seek recourse of Look-out-Circular and under what circumstances?
B. What procedure is required to be followed by the investigating agency before opening a Look- out-circular?
C. What is the remedy available to the person against whom such Look-out-Circular has been opened?
D. What is the role of the concerned Court when such a case is brought before it and under what circumstances, the subordinate courts can intervene?

The questions are answered as under:
A. Recourse to LOC can be taken by investigating agency in cognizable offences under IPC or other penal laws, where the accused was deliberately evading arrest or not appearing in the trial court despite NBWS and other coercive measures and there was likelihood of the accused leaving the country to evade trial/arrest B.

sentences.text: Page No. 6 of 8 the circular of Ministry of Home Affairs, giving details & reasons for seeking LOC.
The competent officer alone shall give directions for opening LOC by passing an order in this respect.

C. The person against whom LOC is issued must join investigation by appearing before I.O. or should surrender before the court concerned or should satisfy the court that LOC was wrongly issued against him.
He may also approach the officer who ordered issuance of LOC & explain that LOC was wrongly issued against him.

LOC can be withdrawn by the authority that issued and can also be rescinded by the trial court where case is pending or having jurisdiction over concerned police station on an application by the person concerned.
D. LOC is a coercive measure to make a person surrender to the investigating agency or Court of law.
The subordinate courts jurisdiction in affirming or cancelling LOC is commensurate with the jurisdiction of cancellation of NBWs or affirming NBWS.
12. It is an admitted position that the impugned Order was passed when the revisionist-accused had not joined the investigation.

But now as the revisionist-accused has joined the investigation and the record shows that he has followed the due process of law regarding cancellation of NBWs issued against him CR No. 149/2023 Arpit Luthra Vs State of NCT of Delhi 16.05.2023 Page No. 7 of 8 and grant of interim protection, the continuation of LOC dated 09.11.2022 would serve no purpose and would be unjustified.

accordingly, hereby cancelled.
13. With these directions, the present revision petition stands disposed of as allowed.
